Committee: Health
Sponsor: Lee
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 184 as introduced would require health care providers to report immunization data to the immunization registry maintained by the State Board of Health and to review the registry before a vaccine is administered with certain exceptions. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of any state and local health care providers that administer vaccinations by an undetermined amount.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 19 as passed the Senate will increase the salary expenses of the Etowah County Board of Registrars, paid from the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $13,700 annually. This bill could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed to the Board from the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 01/27/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 19 as introduced will increase the salary expenses of the Etowah County Board of Registrars, paid from the State General Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2022 by an estimated maximum of $13,700 annually. This bill could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed to the Board, from the State General Fund, also beginning in Fiscal Year 2022 by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
